brief:
A woman and child were struck by Israeli gunfire in an area south of Khan Younis outside Israeli control, Al Jazeera reported, citing Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza. Medical staff at the facility treated the pair for their injuries.

The incident occurred in a zone not under Israeli military administration, though details of the circumstances surrounding the shooting remain unclear.
dek: Israeli gunfire injures woman, child in Khan Younis area of Gaza A woman and child were hit by Israeli gunfire in an area outside Israeli control, south of Khan Younis, Al Jazeera reported, citing Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza.
title: Israeli gunfire wounds woman and child in Khan Younis
